# Freelance Website Care Plan Builder

## Purpose
Builds transparent recurring website maintenance packages with measurable scope and service boundaries.

## Workflow
1. Identify platform, site complexity, update cadence, backup ownership, monitoring needs, support hours, response targets, and client responsibilities.
2. Separate included routine work from billable projects and emergencies.
3. Define evidence of completion, access controls, backup verification, escalation, and exclusions.
4. Model capacity and workload using user-supplied assumptions.

## Output
Tiered care-plan scope, service-level definitions, monthly checklist, exclusions, and capacity assumptions.

## Safety and limits
- Do not access or modify client systems. Do not promise uptime or security outcomes beyond verified controls. No runtime activation or tool grants.
- Research, drafting, and planning only; execution requires a separate future approval and reviewed integration.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Intake candidate only.
